case.period: Notes from Thu 1 Oct to Sun 4 Oct
case.main_concerns: Coursework deadlines and a one-person group project are wearing me down
case.recent_change: My sleep has broken down over the past week and the exhaustion is amplifying everything

excerpts.text: 今天晚上又失眠，躺在牀上一直諗住小組作業嘅事。陳小明話佢會幫手，但係到而家都冇消息。我覺得好攰，個腦停唔到落嚟。
Third night in a row with almost no sleep.
I stayed in the library until midnight again trying to finish the coursework for the statistics module.
I have not slept properly all week.
The coursework is piling up faster than I can clear it.
